name: TJX Companies
outlook:
What TJX Companies says to expect

  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: sales and pretax marginFor the third quarter of Fiscal 2027, the Company is planning consolidated comparable sales to be up 2% to 3%. The Company expects pretax profit margin to be in the range of 12.8% to 12.9%.
  • Third quarter fiscal 2027: earnings per shareThe Company expects diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $1.36 to $1.38. Excluding an expected net benefit of $.06 from tariff refunds, the Company expects adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $1.30 to $1.32.
  • Full year fiscal 2027: sales and pretax marginFor the full year Fiscal 2027, the Company continues to expect consolidated comparable sales to be up 3% to 4%. The Company is increasing its full-year pretax profit margin outlook to be in the range of 12.3% to 12.4%.
  • Full year fiscal 2027: earnings per shareThe Company is increasing its full-year diluted earnings per share outlook to be in the range of $5.31 to $5.36. Excluding an expected net benefit of $.16 from tariff refunds, the Company is increasing its full year outlook for adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $5.15 to $5.20.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed August 19, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
